name: 39406 · Hattiesburg, MS
findings: ZIP 39406 (Hattiesburg) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 39406 (Hattiesburg) has 19 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
